_note: The employer's contribution to the employee's account under the notified pension scheme, "as does not exceed (a) 14%, where such contribution is made by the employer being the Central Government or the State Government" "of his salary in the tax year" (s.124(1)(a), p.160); "salary" includes dearness allowance where the terms provide and excludes all other allowances and perquisites (s.124(13)(b), p.161) — base SALARY, the employer-pension salary. Survives the new regime (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26. rulebook DED-NPS-EMP-001(a), -003. Whether the contribution is salary first is OQ-14. The 1961 counterpart, s.80CCD(2), is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d1). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80CCD(2) as substituted by F(No.2)A 2019 s.24 (p.16): "does not exceed–– (a) fourteen per cent., where such contribution is made by the Central Government", with FA 2022 s.20 (p.28) reading "Central Government or the State Government" from 1-4-2020 — 14% of salary (s.80CCD Explanation, SAL-SALARY-FOR-EMPLOYER-PENSION). Every regime: s.115BAC(2)(i) keeps s.80CCD(2). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B7, M2, M8, M14. D-144.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2022 (6 of 2022), s.20 — "Central Government or the State Government" for "Central Government" in s.80CCD(2), deemed from 1-4-2020; the fourteen per cent. by Finance (No. 2) Act, 2019 s.24
